entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Renatus Profuturus Frigeridus was a fifth-century historian. He wrote a historical work of twelve volumes. It exists today only in brief fragments, a few passages having survived in chapters eight and nine of the second book of Gregory of Tours' Decem libri historiarum. Gregory likewise preserves some quoted material from the late fourth-century historian Sulpicius Alexander.
